title: Low-angle laptop editor tour with agent-made edits
summary: A laptop shot from keyboard level shows a motion editor flipping through sample scenes on every cut, then the camera dives into the UI to watch prompts, retyped labels, icon picks and an export dialog play out under VO.
use_when: a vertical 45-60 s explainer for a creative tool or editor
showing an AI agent or integration driving a real app UI
a social cut where VO carries the story and the UI proves it
products with many sample outputs to flip through in the hook

look.type_style: UI sans (system grotesk), sentence case, normal tracking; canvas lines medium weight ~3 % H; end lines regular ~2.5 % H, centred white on black

sfx.event: canvas content swaps on a cut
text typed in prompt, chip label, product label, URL
pointer clicks an option or icon

params.brand: brand.json: accent drives the sky gradient and the timeline glow; mark for the stroke-drawn logo row
params.content.samples: 6 sample output stills shown on the canvas in the hook montage, one per cut
params.content.styleChips: 5-7 one-word style names rolling in the chip column
params.content.prompt: 4-6 word prompt typed in the pill (row 4)
params.content.integrations: 3-4 cards: icon, name, one-line description, install button
params.content.retypedChip: old and new chip label for the edit row
params.vo: VO script, ~19 short lines at ~2.8 words/s; rows stretch to its line timings
params.aspect: 9:16 native; 4:5 works by widening the laptop crop

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s) plus cut frames. The hook keeps the same laptop framing across 5 cuts at ~29 fr each and changes only the canvas content (proposed term preview-swap). cut_on_beat 3/11 within ±2 fr. VO 143 words over ~51 s (~2.8 w/s), music ducked under it (-23.6 LUFS integrated). SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): preview-swap, mark-stroke-draw.
